note: v2 (16:9), told by Eloise and Eddie. New for this video: split screens (the speaker on one half, their words broken down on the other), the logo on the footage instead of a bumper, a two-line name card, and the Donate card over the last shot. Captions are built in the edit. Oct 27 video notes: everything a little slower (builds spaced out, 2 s holds after key lines), Eloise named once, and no graphic ever sits over moving video. MG 13–15 are seamless FTC-purple background loops that go under Eloise when she is on her own, instead of b-roll.
